note: Ten disjoint decks fit into ten boxes at once. The original seven remain fixed; the final three use the maximum remaining zero-penalty ASH pool, then backfill from SOR. Every card is on-aspect, and premium printings are applied first.

roster.name: Phoenix Ignition
roster.identity: This deck wins by flooding the board with cheap Rebels and letting Sabine's unavoidable base damage finish what coordinated attacks start, before big defenders stabilize.

roster.name: Bounty Compound Interest
roster.identity: This deck wins midrange fights by converting every enemy unit that leaves play into an extra resource through Boba's leader ability, then banking that tempo into premium threats the opponent must answer.

roster.name: Two Fronts, One Rebellion
roster.identity: This deck wins by keeping two ready Rebels at all times and compressing two attacks into one Leia action, creating a damage-and-initiative advantage no defensive line can schedule around.

roster.name: Dead Man's Sightline
roster.identity: Cad's repeatable one-damage ping finishes wounded units and changes every combat calculation; an all-ASH shell of Imperial bodies, Advantage tricks, and attack punishment keeps every fight on his terms.

roster.name: Twin Suns Resurgence
roster.identity: Luke converts every attack into durability; an all-ASH shell of Mandalorian tokens, Sentinels, and restore units wins repeated combats before the capital ships close out the game.

roster.name: Thrawn's Return Protocol
roster.identity: Sloane turns every surviving Imperial into a Sentinel and Overwhelm threat. Cheap troopers and TIEs contest both arenas until the Prestige Foil Thrawn converts Support into repeat attacks.

roster.name: Gilded Nevarro Circuit
roster.identity: Greef turns a newly played unit into immediate Advantage pressure each round. A premium SOR/ASH shell uses cheap space bodies, tempo upgrades, and resilient late threats to keep both arenas productive.

roster.name: Charming Last Stand
roster.identity: Grogu deploys early from seven copies of unique units that cost 4 or more. Sentinel and Ambush bodies hold both arenas while Cunning tempo turns protected attacks into steady board advantage.

roster.name: Initiative Is the Way
roster.identity: The Mandalorian rewards claiming initiative with extra cards. Support, Ambush, and ready effects compress attacks into fewer actions, while a compact Mandalorian package and Command finishers keep the pressure from running dry.

roster.name: The Emperor’s Long Game
roster.identity: Palpatine turns a wide board of cheap units into massive Advantage attacks. Thirty early plays establish both arenas, instant-attack effects spend temporary power quickly, and Command ramp reaches the late Imperial finishers.
